svg.text: Pharmacy Inventory & POS: Firestore data model
Inside each pharmacy: subcollections of pharmacies/{pharmacyId}
Dashed box = stored inside its parent, not a collection
• Money is stored as whole Rwandan francs (int). The app takes no payments: paymentMethod is only a label.
• Snapshot fields (…Name, batchNumber) copy a value at the time of the event, so history still reads correctly after a rename.
• Batches keep pharmacyId so one collection-group query can find expiring stock across all products of a pharmacy.
• Receipt numbers come from pharmacies.nextReceiptNo, increased in the same transaction that saves the sale.
